memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "They said to one another, 'Surely we are being punished because of our brother. We saw how distressed he was when he pleaded with us for his life, but we would not listen; that's why this distress has come on us.' Reuben replied, 'Didn't I tell you not to sin against the boy? But you wouldn't listen! Now we must give an accounting for his blood.'" - Gen 42:21-22 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
More than twenty years have passed, yet the moment the brothers face trouble, an old memory comes flooding back: "Surely we are being punished because of our brother." They recall in vivid detail how Joseph pleaded for his life while they callously refused to listen. The guilt they had buried for two decades rises to the surface as if it happened yesterday.

This is a striking picture of the persistence of an unconfessed conscience. The brothers had done their best to forget Joseph, to move on, to bury the memory of their cruelty. But guilt that is never confessed and dealt with does not truly disappear; it goes underground and waits. And in a moment of pressure, it surfaces with full force.

Buried sin is not the same as forgiven sin. We may push a wrong out of our minds, distract ourselves for years, and think we have moved past it. But an unhealed conscience quietly carries the weight, and it will resurface — often at the hardest moments. As David discovered, hidden sin can waste us from within until we bring it into the open (Ps 32:3-5).

Is there something buried in your own conscience — a wrong never confessed, a person never made right with, a guilt you have tried to forget? The way to freedom is not to bury it deeper but to bring it into the light. Confess it to God, and to anyone you have wronged. Only sin brought into the open can be truly healed.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Is there buried guilt I have tried to forget rather than face?
2. Do I confuse forgetting sin with dealing with it?
3. What do I need to bring into the light for healing?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, search my conscience for anything buried and unconfessed. Give me courage to bring it into the light rather than bury it deeper. Thank You that confessed sin finds Your healing and mercy. Amen.
